name: Gov AI: Decentralized Polling System
tagline: Wallet-verified polls on Solana with AI analysis of the results.
problem: Online polls are easy to manipulate and hard to trust.
solution: Users authenticate with a Solana wallet signature, vote in cryptographically verified polls, and see AI-powered analysis of the outcomes.
demo_moment: Team-described: connect a wallet, vote, and see the verified tally and analysis.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “[MLH] Best Use of Solana” among 82 submissions.
Chose the sponsor with the steepest learning curve on purpose.

lessons: Fewer teams attempt the hardest sponsor stack; finishing it can be enough.
